check_scope.automated_exhaustive: schema fields, unique IDs, exactly four distinct options, key text agreement, banned phrasings, dash and ASCII style, exact and near-duplicate stems bank-wide, cross-chapter key sequence, option-length leakage, answer position balance
check_scope.model_review: Every new question was solved blind (without the key) by an independent model examiner; all disagreements and flags (47) plus 68 option-length leaks were resolved, and the 106 revised items were solved blind a second time with zero disagreements.
check_scope.human_subject_expert_review: Not performed. Recommend a teacher spot-check, especially Assertion-Reason items, where whether the Reason explains the Assertion is a judgement call.
check_scope.ncert_page_check: Not performed for new items: NCERT PDFs were not accessible during the build, so new items cite the NCERT section title, not a page number. Content was written to the rationalised NCERT text from model knowledge.
check_scope.difficulty_labels: Editorial estimates, not calibrated from student data.
